title: Space Quiz

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explain: Iron oxide on its surface gives Mars its red color.

questions.q: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
What is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.explain: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as all other planets combined.

rulesText: Answer 3 questions. You have 20 seconds for each one.
